name: Tose Naina Milaike
overview: Kuhu is a selfless, cheerful and unconventional looking girl who lives in Muniyatola, a village where people come to buy brides. Kuhu believes her unattractive looks are a blessing from God, as she will stay with her parents forever because marriage is out of question for her. But her life changes when she and her sister get married to the two brothers of a rich family that has a mysterious past.
